high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "dailywicca." The post features a collection of ornate metal keys displayed against a dark background. The keys vary in design, with some featuring intricate patterns and others having simpler shapes. The text overlay on the image reads: "A quick way to attract positive energy while simultaneously deflecting negative energy is to keep a metal key on you at all times. Magick keys open doors of opportunity. Old metal keys are the best. They have unlocked many doors before finding their way to you.
